stimulus:
I will arise and go now, and go to Innisfree,
And a small cabin build there, of clay and wattles made;
Nine bean-rows will I have there, a hive for the honey-bee,
And live alone in the bee-loud glade.

And I shall have some peace there, for peace comes dropping slow,
Dropping from the veils of the morning to where the cricket sings;
There midnight's all a glimmer, and noon a purple glow,
And evening full of the linnet's wings.

I will arise and go now, for always night and day
I hear lake water lapping with low sounds by the shore;
While I stand on the roadway, or on the pavements grey,
I hear it in the deep heart's core.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Persistence After Signal Withdrawal (the lake that keeps lapping)
ideas.description: Pulse cells with a defined AP-1 stimulus (e.g., TPA, EGF, or LPS), wash it out, and track AP-1 occupancy (CUT&RUN for c-Jun/c-Fos), chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq), and nascent transcription (PRO-seq) at target enhancers over days. Memory requires that the altered state outlasts the stimulus, so loci that stay open or bound after the signal is gone are the strongest candidates.

ideas.title: Inducible Degron Erasure Test
ideas.description: Tag endogenous JUN or FOS with an auxin-inducible degron (e.g., AID2), prime cells, then degrade the factor during the quiescent gap before re-challenge. If AP-1 is the memory store, degradation should erase the primed chromatin state and faster reinduction; if the primed state survives, AP-1 is only a readout of an independent store.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation Kinetics at Primed Versus Naive Loci
ideas.description: Compare first and second responses to the same stimulus, measuring time-to-peak, fold induction, and the number of activated AP-1 target genes, alongside locus-specific CRISPR deletion or mutation of individual AP-1 motifs. A memory mechanism predicts faster, stronger reinduction that depends on the specific motifs at primed enhancers, not on global AP-1 levels.

ideas.title: Single-Cell AP-1 Reporter with Lineage Tracing
ideas.description: Build a fast-degrading AP-1 reporter (destabilized fluorescent protein under AP-1 response elements) and track single cells through several divisions after pulses of different duration and frequency. Heritable, history-dependent reporter states that persist across mitosis, and correlate between sister cells, would indicate a stable cellular memory rather than a transient response.

ideas.title: Mitotic Inheritance of AP-1-Marked Chromatin
ideas.description: Prime cells, arrest them in mitosis, and use mitotic ChIP or ATAC on sorted mitotic cells to test whether AP-1 and its primed accessibility persist on chromosomes through division. Repeat in vivo with a tissue-specific Fos or Jun conditional knockout, priming with a repeated inflammatory or injury stimulus and challenging weeks later, to check whether the memory requires AP-1 at the organismal level.
